about: A3 G17: Black-76 reference vectors, shared by the Python (tests/stockify/test_black76.py) and C++ (engine/tests/test_black76.cpp) tests. Prices in rupees, t in years (ACT/365; `days` means days/365), vega per 1.00 of volatility. Expected values are strings so that their printed precision is known: prices must match within 1e-6 absolute (A3 §3) or half a unit in the last printed digit if coarser; Greeks within 1e-9 relative or half a unit in the last printed digit, whichever is wider.

vectors.source: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives, Black's model example: a European put on a futures, F = K = 20, r = 9%, sigma = 25%, 4 months; Hull prints 1.12, A3 G17 quotes 1.1166
